comment: The Crawford lake area is blocked by construction.  August 13
Beautiful views over the cliffs and great views of the Niagara escarpment
Th boardwalk around the lake was closed today
The wooden boardwalk around the lake is completely ripped up under construction so couldn’t get a view of of the lake sadly, but everything else was good. Lots of wildlife out
Spring blooms starting and turkey vultures soaring :)
Very nice trail. Saw lots of Turkey Vultures flying around in the brouce part of the trail above the canyon. Would come again in the summer.
Peaceful, well packed snow, not icy today.
Some part of the trail it’s close
Amazing trail that’s not super technical. Only thing right now is the entire boardwalk portion of the trail is closed until January 2026.
Great views and good fall lookout spots. It was a bit strenuous.
A really beautiful trail, very forestry for the most part.
Nice walk
Great, I'll come back

Very satisfying hike. We would skip the boardwalk around the lake next time. Really enjoyed getting off the main track and into the trails. Quiet and beautiful. There is a section on the Bruce trail that was simply delightful. The rock formations were so interesting and fun to walk on. We are 65, quite fit and found this to be a moderate hike. Good variety. Not too buggy. Not too long.  We’ve marked it to do again in the next few weeks.
Well-maintained trail and nice boardwalk around the lake - bring bug spray
Varying terrain. And mostly shaded, but some sunny sections.
Well maintained trails, the  Bruce trail sections can get slippery.Today was a particularly humid day making it a bit strenuous.
Great trail; too many bugs though!
A perfect day for a long hike. No one on the trails early in the morning.
It’s an amazing trail. I often come here and it’s always good hike and great experience
You have to pay to enter the park but it is well worth it with beautiful trails

Amazingly green and lush foliage along the trail! We had perfect weather and there weren’t any bugs. Loved the Bruce trail section and the Crawford lake trail has many seating areas overlooking the lake. Excited to come back.
Awesome hike, the lake is beautiful to see while boardwalking. Nicely maintained and taken care of. And surprisingly less mosquitoes haha

Excellent trails. 
Rocky, uneven and great conditions.
Great trail,  took the family and dog
Trail is absolutely gorgeous, easy terrain and not too muddy. Very busy on a Friday morning. Park hours are posted on the website, pay to park!
Always a favourite and so beautiful when covered in a blanket of fresh snow!
Some noise pollution at times but beautiful trail!
Beautiful fall colours!
Conservation area - reservation is recommended
There are lots of wood features and rocks on this trail, so it's quite slippery after it rains

You won't find anything like it. It's about $12 per person to get in. But it's well worth it, because the park has re-built longhouses to showcase a unique history behind the lake and land. This one's a must!
Lovely broad walk, spectacular views, fairly easy to walk.
Mosquitos Aug 24/24. Got to keep moving.
Nice views, good escarpment trail. Enjoyed the boardwalk trail! Be prepared for the bugs. Overall highly recommend!
not bad but a little boring and SO MANY BUGS

Went around 1pm on a Saturday.  It's not a crowded park but the boardwalk loop was busy with 2 bus trips. The Bruce Trail loop is very rocky, was a bit muddy and heavy on bugs. So bring repellant. Just one warning: The meadows have barely maintained trails so the grass was tall and could be a tick haven. Beautiful trail, great parking, easy to find.

The trail was a smooth ride with some rocky parts and some muddy parts. The mosquitos were not too bad. I would recommend to book your reservation online beforehand and to download your map prior as there are little to no data availability in the park.
A gorgeous hike with great views. A few rocky spots but relatively easy to navigate.

Beautiful trail system with lots of possibilities and great views! However, a bit difficult to understand parking/reserving (it’s all automated now but not entirely clear), could be better stated on the website.
Easy for a family walk.chill and quiet.
Trails are great, well kept. Washrooms are available. The reconstructed long houses are cool as well as the little events they host to teach you different things.
Great trail conditions! Very little mud, no bugs.
Touch muddy in places and few trails closed with Ash maintenance (as highlighted on website) inc. walkway around Lake. Beautiful spot.
A little mud and no ice today.
There was more snow and ice left than I expected on the trail. Be careful.
Mix of boardwalk groomed trail and wooded trail.
Rattlesnake hiking 20231022

Went during the week to avoid crowds, but during the week I discovered school kids come as well. Park was busy on the Crawford Lake route, but quiet on the rest of the trail. Trails are well maintained. It was a nice day hike. Somehow there were still mosquitos, but very few.

Beautiful trails with a variety of terrain. Well maintained and well marked. Crawford Lake loop is of east difficultly and you’re able to bring a stroller along the boardwalk. Escarpment trail is rocky and of moderate difficulty—you aren’t wheeling anything down there. Lol. Park can be crowded on weekends. Go during the week to be left alone in nature.
Minimal bugs some rocky.parts overall beautiful.
A great trail full of rock, root and rot. A couple nice viewpoints along the way. A bit muddy in some areas and slippery in others but nothing too bad. I'll be back come winter to explore again.
There r bugs

Bugs were moderate in the back part of the trail. No mud. Pretty busy on the lake part of the trail but better in the back loop. Takes way longer than 1 hr and 30 minutes as someone mentioned and we didn't make any stops longer than for water breaks. Will be good in the fall for sure.

Always a lovely hike with a combination of challenging rocky trails along the edge of the Escarpment and easy wide paths meandering through the rest of the park.  And the Lake itself is always so peaceful.

Crawford lake was a beautiful loop, definitely read about this fascinating lake before you arrive. the loop after the lake was great as well, bring bug spray and hiking shoes for rocks and mud. the connecting trail over to the second half of this trail was closed off, said fory maintenance/reforestation.  looked like maybe fallen trees and debris blocking the path, sad to miss that full 2.5 hour trail but the 1.5 was still great! went to Hilton Falls after for an extra hour of hiking, only ten minutes away

Enjoyable hike! Lots of rocks and roots to navigate over in some sections putting it slightly up from the  “easy” rating. The first section around the boardwalk was nice and easy but then we were lead onto narrower, less populated trails. Was hoping to see a deer but no such luck this time.
be prepared. mosquitos will follow you like a vampiric cloud just waiting for you to stop. otherwise quite pretty. definitely on the easy side. wide flat trails through the forest
Excellent variety of hiking
Trail is muddy on Naasagewa canyon so we had to cut short. Rest everything is fine. Good trail. Love the lake trail.
Trail is noted as « easy » but with the soft snow it was very challenging - like hiking through deep soft sand

Fun and easy hike not too far from the city. Trail was well maintained and had a nice variety of terrain. There were some slippery/icy sections we were glad to have crampons for but it would be doable without them. We also enjoyed seeing the long houses and one of the staff gave us seeds to feed the chickadees.
Snow helped smooth out the trail today.
Getting slippery be careful!
Some mud but overall fairly clear trails. Level 3 trails offer a good mix of hiking and escarpment views.
You’ve got to reserve a time online before arriving!
Beautiful day
Not a continuous wheelchair friendly path. Had to turn back after 10 minutes.
Frickin sweet
very nice and easy hike. perfect with kids.
It was pretty buggy out but Crawford Lake is always a beautiful hike.
Great trail! Besides, we saw a white-tailed deer
great loop
Very nice hike. Good views and variety of forest. Need boots to protect from twisting ankles.
Muddy but easy
No need for snow shoes are cramping, well packed and well marked trail￼
Great day out in perfect weather and great trail maintenance.
Awesome!!!! Wonderful snowshoeing at Crawford Lake - did the ‘snowshoe’ specific trails first - they are gorgeous! Before continuing with on with the Bruce Trail and side trails.  See recording.
Great views! Wasn’t able to completely finish it but next time!
Icey along the boardwalk surrounding Crawford Lake
Great fun! ￼The hike is fairly easy but because of the rocks you do require some stability to enjoy. There are only a few uphill climb and the views are beautiful.￼
Beautiful but in October it was pretty muddy and treacherous on the rocks.
Great trail Easy to navigate .
awesome hike, a few narrow parts along the ridge, good shade, can be buggy in summer so bring lots of spray. lookout spot is outstanding
Good workout but not an easy trail along the top of the canyon. A  nerve racking if you are afraid of heights.
Amazing trail with a gorgeous view of the lake! Could def be rated as moderate in some places due to lots of rocks, roots, inclines etc
Lovely trail. Varied difficulty for sure from the boardwalk to the Bruce Trail proper.
Need reservation before coming. Nice trail, a lot of ppl.
5 star
Several options for trails. This place is beautiful and great for hikes. The lake boardwalk is a great way to finish off your hike.
muddy and icy
Good brisk walk in March cool air.  Some sections are still covered with snow.
Great trails but today you really need spikes!
A beautiful afternoon hike. Didn’t need crampons today!
Great area - tons of trail options, great views and well marked. Highly recommend.
Lots of variety of views. Escarpment so you look down onto the valley. A good 2 hours

A bit muddy with snow melt but a nice walk with pleasant woodsy, mostly easy terrain. Note the boardwalk around the lake is apparently one way traffic only, and I came at it from the wrong side and had two persons very unhappy with me! 
Otherwise not a busy trail on a winter weekday, especially the BT portions. 
Next time I'll use the Twiss Rd entry and avoid the visitor area entirely.
for a park requiring reservations due to Covid-19, it was way to busy and people on trails were rude. very unusual in my experiences
Brisk but lovely fall hike
Really great fall hike
Great
Boardwalk around the lake, some wide gravel trails, and then a lot of nice quiet trails through the woods, over rocks, and lots of lookouts. Will be nice in the fall!
Very scenic hike. Well-marked trails. It can get very busy here. We were disappointed to find out the canyon section of the trail was closed. It would’ve been nice to know that before we paid.
Nice trail for a short hike, busy at the beginning but I didn’t see anyone beyond the lake. Lots of rocky terrain so make sure your shoes are comfortable.
Nassagavaya trail is closed. Few bugs on the north end ( Bruce trail portion)
What makes this trail the best is the secret spot overlooking to canyon.
Did half the trail. Easy to moderate, suitable with dogs and children except for a short path near the cliffs. Trails currently muddy with little bits of ice in sections.

This was a great trail, but I recommend going when it's dry out! A large portion of the trail is very Rocky and it gets really slippery climbing over them after it's rained, so be careful! This trail is great for beginners and moderate level hikers, not too challenging at all! I did the trail with my dog today and he also approves!
Very nice trail. Quite rocky for the first km or so, really had to watch your footing, but the rest of the trail was great.
